reviews.comment: She was actually really sweet and provided us with everything needed to do well in class. write the practice exams and hw on the cheat sheet and the exams will be easy. truly do recommend her.

The expectations from the University on what we can learn in this class are so unreasonable that I don't know if Dao is a good instructor or not, but she is very kind.  She always left nice comments on my exams after grading them and I know she believed in me. The course itself is ungodly, try not to work while you're taking this class if possible.

Although the other reviews are right about her hard accent and boring lectures, she makes the course easy. All the exams are ONLINE AT HOME, and attendance is not mandatory. With the exception of pop quizzes every now and then only worth 2% of your grade. Easily get an A without doing them. Homework is weekly and very easily done resourcefully.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Although the reviews are correct with her hard accent and boring lectures, the course is not bad itself and she makes it easy. All exams are ONLINE AT HOME. Attendance isn't mandatory but you does give pop quizzes every now and then that are only worth 2% of your grade. If you don't go a single time you will still get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. Dao was nice but did not seem interested in teaching statistics, and lectures were not engaging in the slightest. Topics in lectures, homework, and exams were not difficult but had almost no correlation to eachother. There was no clear learning objective for a majority of units, and I truly feel like I haven't learned anything from this class.

Lot of hate, but R is hard in general, the class is doable. She does care and want you to understand, ask her ?. She changed grading this sem: HW+4 tests+final, instead of just 2, less material per exam, so much easier to get A, she listened to student feedback. Test reviews & practice exams very helpful! Don't stress if you get her, she's changed.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I think this class with this prof is overhated. This was honestly one of my blow off classes this semester. As long as you go to class and understand the R coding, it's not that bad at all! People say the exams are confusing but I never really ran into that problem. Don't let these reviews scare you, it's truly not that bad

Lectures are pretty useless, because it's just her reading the slides and then writing non-sense that doesn't help. There are extra credit pop quizzes which are nice. Tests always have some intentionally confusing questions. If you write a good study sheet the day before and do the practice tests, it's 100% possible to make an 80 on the tests.

Okay honestly, people are being overly harsh with her. yes, her lectures are boring, but she'll help you if you just ask. The random pop quizzes are easily predicted in my opinion, and they're for extra credit anyway. The exams and practice tests were relatively similar. Tests are online and recorded but you get a cheat sheet so it's not bad at all

My grade was mostly my fault but she gave zero handouts to help. She is hard to understand and has boring monotonous lectures that are not as helpful as just reading the slides on your own but oh oops you have to go to every class because there miiiiight be a pop quiz. The exams were pretty difficult and the course's grading criteria is not clear

This is actually the worst prof i have come across.She does not care about you or your grade. You can go to class and do everything in your power but you will not get a A because her exams and homeworks and lectures are completly unrelated. Her exams were so unfair and she refuses to giveback credit even when 99% of the class chose "wrong" choice.

She's an okay lecturer. If you're a freshman and you took AP stats in high school, then the first few lectures won't be as difficult. The exams are okay too (can be a bit confusing), but you are allowed a cheat sheet. All the exams are online using lockdown browser. Definitely attend lectures or you will be confused and ask questions!
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Personally, I didn't think this class was terrible but I can understand why people struggle. That being said she is a terrible professor. Rude, doesn't explain anything, gives no grace on anything, and it feels like she makes the class intentionally confusing. Only good thing is she gives 5% of your grade back as extra credit for attending lect.

Monotone, quiet and inattentive lecturer. No correlation between lectures, homework and tests. Practice tests are nothing like the actual tests. No wiggle room for missed points on homework or tests- very unforgiving. Goes back on what she is talking about during lecture, causing confusion. Good luck. I'd start praying.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: if the class is 99% r-studio, why does she specifically not allow us to use it on the exam? grades to 105%, 5% pop quizzes. allows a cheat sheet, but i can copy the whole lec verbatim + still get a C. monotone, frequent mistakes on slides. even though i'm on track to pass, i'm considering retaking the class w a diff prof to save my gpa. good luck.

This rating would've been a 2 because of her not-so-great teaching abilities and handwriting, but out of all STAT211 sections, her exams weigh the least. 
You get an opportunity to add an extra 2% to your grade via pop quizzes; however, those are sometimes unfair.

i REALLY don't understand the hate for this prof. the exams are straightforward and you get a double sided cheat sheet. as long as you understand the coding platform, this class is a breeze and not really that much work.
Doesn't explain well and tests are unfair
just trust me guys do not take her pls

Professor Dao isn't a bad person- She's real sweet. However, her teaching style isn't very helpful, and you pretty much have to self teach. TA SI/Office hours are a lifesaver (kinda), but you have to do the in depth learning yourself. 5 exams, mixed question format.  If you can, take another prof. If not, you'll PROBABLY be fine. PROBABLY.

Despite frequent pop quizzes for participation, lectures are sparsely attended. Homework and exams are easy, with a cheat sheet, R, the stats site's normal distribution tool, and a scientific calculator allowed. Unfortunately, her lectures are pretty bad, and asking questions often leaves you more confused.

I took this course over the summer and it was 5 exams, 10 homework assignments. The HW is all in R studio, but the exams do not allow you to use R studio. Dr. Dao lacks the ability to explain things. She is very difficult to follow and honestly is just not helpful at all for studying for the exam. Take any other prof. Trust me.

This course was organized very poorly.  I felt that there wasn't much on the exams that was given in the review. All of the homework is in R-Studio and you cant even use R-Studio on the exams. I felt so lost in class and had difficulty with staying engaged. She was very hard to understand and follow. 2 exams, in class participation, weekly homework

She is very kind and obviously knowledgeable in statistics but not a good professor. Her lectures are very confusing and she is not good at explaining concepts. Lots of HWs (fairly easy), 2 exams and 1 final. Random in class quizzes at least once a week (worth good amt of points) TA review sessions are a lifesaver for this course.

Dr. Dao is very knowledgeable, but her lectures can be a bit difficult to follow if you are not actively paying attention and writing everything down. Go to recitations and office hours. Make sure you understand the lecture material as there are 1-2 pop quizzes each week. HWs and tests are pretty easy if you pay attention.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures are hard to grasp especially with the language barrier (hard to explain in english). I got used to it over time, but it was still difficult. Go to recitation. Lookover slides and try to explain to yourself concepts. There are few 3rd party resources that would help you with the material. Dao is not mean at all though, very reasonable.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you have the opportunity to take any other professor, I suggest you do so. She is extremely disorganized, hard to understand, and boring. The exams aren't the worst, but if you do badly on one of them, it'll be very hard to recover. The quizzes are not worth that much, but they are easy to mess up on so make sure to do those well. HW's are easy.

without a doubt the most ridiculous class you will take while at A&M. If you don't do well on one of the exams, you can forget about an A. She does pop quizzes for credit that she doesn't give any notice of (make up 10% of your grade). Go to class and do your best to pay attention even though lectures are a snoozefest. She is very quiet/monotone.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures are boring and she holds random pop quizzes at the end of the lecture, she also doesn't seem to remember the passwords to her exams and quizzes so it wastes our time as well.

Lecutres are decent, she simply does a lot of problems which really helps you understand the material. Highly recommend using R for this course (makes exams a joke). The class in general is super easy. If you think you can ace the class, I would take another professor since she does have mandatory attendance with quizzes.
Terrible lecturer, but she has random quizzes, so you have to show up and waste an hour of your time. Take anyone but her.

This professor is quite possibly one of the worst professors that I have had the displeasure to take during my time here at A&M. Her lectures were boring, her handwriting illegible, and she practically whispered into the microphone the entire time. The recitation leader was my saving grace -- she posted videos, and I learned everything from them.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: very disorganized lecturer, I stopped paying attention after like 4 weeks bc i just got lost. studied the day before the 2 tests and somehow made an A on both. background stats knowledge is helpful but not necessary. very doable class, just study the slides. id suggest checking hw with others & taking turns submitting first each week lol

Awful prof & awful lecturer. Her ENTIRE class is about doing Stats problems via coding platform R Studio, that's ALL she "teaches" (not well tho), BUT her exams do not allow you to use R Studio, so you have to know how to do it by hand, WHICH SHE NEVER TEACHES. One of the worst profs in my undergrad, but I had to take the class to graduate :(
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I feel like people are a bit harsh. She does have an accent, but it isn't to hard to understand. If you're confused, just go up and ask her. I've gone up and asked her about HW questions and she'll give me the answer. Quizzes are easy peasy, I've missed a few of them and they didn't affect my grade much.

The class itself isn't hard if you read recitation slides before exams but she's a very unorganized lecturer. Listening to her go over notes is more confusing than doing it on your own. She once asked us what homo sapiens was and pulled up a chart about primates and asked "i see humans on the chart but no homo sapiens?". Tests aren't hard though.

Her lectures are boring, but they help you understand major concepts so that you can do well on the weekly quizzes. Homework gets harder as the semester goes on, but exams are much easier than the assignments. For exams, review all lecture slides and make sure you understand the R code given. Reviews are similar to the exams, so do those as well.

If you really put effort into this class it's possible to make an A. Study excessively for the tests, because they are really the only things that affect your grade besides the homeworks. Use the cheat sheet to your advantage on exams, they are lifesavers. I cant stress this enough: go to the TA sessions because they are so helpful for the homework

If you mess up on one exam, you're pretty much done. Lectures are confusing with no clear organization, HWs are somewhat helpful, and exams are unnecessarily tricky especially with the wording. Cheat sheets is the only pro in this class.

2 tests + a final make up 65% of your grade. The lectures are incredibly boring and seem to cast a sleep spell on everyone. Homework mildly relates to lecture, but definitely includes concepts that weren't taught. Only saving graces are TAs who help you with HW and the cheat sheet (1 sheet for tests, a 1 page for final).
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's not the worst, but not great. 2 midterms and a final make up most of your grade, if one goes badly it is hard to recover. Some exam questions were purposely tricky imo. If you go to her officer hours she'll explain everything you ask. My ap stats knowledge was mildly helpful, but I would still say this class was harder than it needs to be.
Her lectures are straight-up boring and it gets tough to pay attention when I don't understand the concepts. Tried paying attention all year but it is impossible.

Don't take this prof. Take 302 if you can, she is unbearable. Tests are easy if you know what to study but lectures are incomprehensible. TA's are good, and they will help you with your homework if you need it, but that's the only saving grace. I saw some kid fight 10 silverback gorillas outside of Blocker instead of going to lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The entire class is coding in R. Weekly homework was not clear. If you ask a few questions after every class about the weekly homeworks you should be fine. Exams are moderately difficult, but she lets you have a cheat sheet for each exam. Her slides made no sense to me, but I made sure to always go to lecture. 2 exams and a cumulative final.

You are allowed an entire cheat sheet for the exam, which makes the class easy. Homework is clear and not hard. Her accent is strong and no one goes to lecture since she only goes over slides. If you ask her question you make end up more confused but the material is simple and there are so many videos over this class' concepts.

She has no clue what she is doing. If you ask her a question, she will ask you to use Google as a 'resource' or redirect you to her TA who is only slightly more competent. I would rather fight ten silverback gorillas than sit an hour in her lecture because she is whispering with her head down as if she were speaking to the ants.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly, prof Dao is not great but her exams are easy. I think all profs who teach 312 have bad ratings, so she's probably the least bad out of the options. Most people just watched the recitation recordings instead of going to class, but i found that if you just try to understand during her lectures they can be useful as well.

Although the class and material itself is not difficult she does not provide any nuanced explanations. Overall she is a pretty bad lecturer which is expected from a college professor. However, the class is made much more difficult if you have a scholarship or gpa minimum you need to maintain stay away and a get a better prof

Simply put this is one of the worst lecturers at A&M. Very easy class for the most part but it is not due to her abilities. Extremely boring class and if you show up expecting to learn something you will quickly be asleep.

Her lectures are sloppy! Recitations can help clear this up, and is the saving grace of the class. This class took more effort than Organic Chemistry to make an A, and she changed the syllabus from 5 quizzes to 1 quiz worth 5% of the grade with only 2 days notice. Would recommend ANYONE else.

Her lectures were unbearable. I only went to lecture three times because of how bad it was. If you took AP Stats in high school then you're gonna be fine in this class. Otherwise, she posts all the slides on Canvas so you can look and see how to do everything. If you actually want to learn statistics, take Crawford or somebody else.

This professor is TERRIBLE. She does not teach in class, she is hard to understand and barely knows how to speak English. She puts all her notes on one slide and it ends up being a super messy slide with tons of notes that are unreadable and written over each other. Avoid. Had to teach myself this course.

Absolute worst professor I've had. Never clear enough on what she expects from homework, constant grammar mistakes & typos in exams and homeworks that make you question what you're doing. I've never had a worse lecturer either. Her head is down the whole time, she whispers and barely interacts with the class. DO NOT take her.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: By far the WORST professor or teacher I've ever had. No one could understand a single word she said. Horrible lecturer nobody understands her chicken scratch on the slides, makes a lot of mistakes, and is very monotone, so you could easily fall asleep. Makes lies in her syllabus, is very unorganized, and Chat gpt taught me the entire course!!

Probably the worst lecturer I've ever had. Her head is buried in notes during lectures, she speaks quietly and often gets lost. Homework assignments are reasonable, exams are average, and you get a 1-page cheat sheet. It's a code-heavy class in R, easy stats 201 stuff. Recitations and other videos taught me way better than the prof taught.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is exclusively in R code. STAT201 knowledge is the only saving grace, because she will NOT explain things. Whispers all throughout class. There was supposed to be 4 quizzes according to the syllabus and somehow she forget to give 3 of those quizzes this year. Recitations are your only form of learning. Dont show up to class. Worst prof!!

Professor Dao was very respectful and responds to emails fairly quickly. She does not require attendance because she posts the power points online. However, they are helpful to ask questions and gather extra information. Overall,  she was a great professor and I would definitely recommend.

stopped going to lecture bc TA's recitation vids taught me more tbh. when I did go she was very monotone & quiet, sometimes confused herself, & scribbled all over the slides. 1st half was easy bc info from stats, 2nd half was hard bc new material for me. has 1pg cheat sheet for 2 exams + final, only 1 quiz, hw gets harder & is time consuming

Professor Daos lectures are extremely hard to follow with her thick accent as well as her ineligible handwriting. Our class had about 10 people show up to the lectures and the other 90 only show up on exam days. Exams had practice online that were similar and you're allowed a cheat sheet. Take Crawford or just watch his videos instead of class.

allows 1 page cheat sheet for exams, they are short & not super difficult if you understand the content. her accent does not effect teaching and shes nice but her lectures were really confusing to me so i watched lectures from scott crawford outside of class instead. seriously watch his videos on youtube instead of wasting time in lecture.

Professor Dao is terrible at lecturing; you are best getting your information elsewhere. She is hard to follow, both in her speech and her writing. There are many mistakes in her work, and the slides are unintelligible. The homework assignments start off with a normal amount of questions, but later, can be anywhere from 170 to 200+ parts, very long
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Dao really tries to help her students succeed. It was her first semester teaching this class and I thought it went well. She does make some errors during her lectures but is quick to fix them. All questions are met with an answer. Take her!

I never went to class because I honestly would not have gotten anything out of it. From the classes I did go to, she was hard to understand and moved very slowly. But it is very doable to get an A in this class if you don't miss a homework and do well on the tests. You get two full practice tests to study for each test and nothing was surprising
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The class itself is very easy; 3 multiple choice exams with cheat sheet, 3 quizzes, and homework almost every week. The professor however doesn't do a good job explaining at all, and is incredibly messy with her lecture notes. she did end up dropping the lowest quiz and homework grade, but if you expect to actually learn don't take her.

She is not very good at explaining or teaching the material and most people never bothered to show up to class (I never paid attention). The homeworks are painful and hard for no reason. The exams are very easy and is the only reason I did well in this class because I understand nothing! But honestly not terrible simply bc the class is easy.

The class itself was very easy with one homework assignment almost every week and the exams were very easy if you do the practice exams. We were also allowed a cheat sheet for the exams. Although the lectures are hard to follow the slides are posted and have everything you need to know.

Heard a lot of conflicting opinions about her but the class is not hard if you study right. You just have to know what to look out for in her lectures- 99% of the math is irrelevant, the programming code is what you'll be tested on. Read the lecture slides, ask questions, and (most importantly!) attend TA sessions and you'll do good in this class.

The WORST lecturer I have ever had. She speaks so quietly with her head down. Her notes in lecture are so messy that even she becomes confused.Homework does not correlate with the information covered in class. The only guide for the weekly homeworks are the lecture slides which lack any useful information.

She puts her head down and lectures from the beginning of lecture to the end. Not only does she mess up her own slides, but she answers questions very poorly and fails to help students understand what they are really learning. She is one of the worst lecturers at A&M. Class is completely self taught and recitations are the only saving grace. 0/10

There are no ratings for Dao's 312 class, so it must be her first year teaching it in 2022, but she is not a very good lecturer, at this point nobody shows up for lecture and she is difficult to follow in class. Planning on teaching myself the material with the TA's help, will update at the end of the semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Terrible professor, lectures are like navigating a dark maze with a BIC lighter. Run away. Please, please run away.

Lectures were a bit boring but pretty thorough and the powerpoints contain almost everything you need to know; HWs weren't hard but were pretty long and tedious. not a hard class if you have a background in stats such as AP Statistics.

I took this class online so it may be different but I recommend you strongly avoid this professor. The exam questions are fairly easy, but theyre so poorly worded with ambiguous rounding requirements that even if you solve the problem correctly you still might be marked incorrect. She frequently makes mistakes and goes over time during lectures.

Homeworks are long, lectures are useless. Really all you gotta do is the test reviews she puts out and most of the questions on the test are gonna come from those. What sucks is 70% of your grade comes from exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dao was nice, lectures were pretty monotonous and barely anyone ever showed up. There were 13 hw's and 3 exams. Hws were not too hard, you get 5 tries per question so its great and some questions have practice options too. She gave us 6 practice exams and they were really close to actual exams too.

Class is set up pretty straightforward. You get 10 hw assignments which are pretty easy, takes maybe an hr or two at most. I stopped showing up after a month, most of the information you can get just by looking at her lecture slides. Exams are also fairly easy. Her exams are mostly based off the reviews she gives on WebAssign.
Review reflects final pretty well. Easy class, but you'll learn more by self-study than attending her lectures. She's very understanding nonetheless
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hard to understand and spends a lot of class time redoing problem as she is prone to making them while working out the examples. The only good thing is that the reviews are very similar to the exams.

I took her when all others STAT classes were full. But she is alright, the review was similar to the test. Only 3 tests and homework. She is reachable after class time, if you want to meet her. The lecture was sometimes wrong, and she fixed it on point right away. Not an outstanding Professor, but you can believe in her.
